title: Supreme Court stays Goa township project after plea alleges violation of status quo order

ai.summary: The Supreme Court stayed a 130-acre township project in Carapur village, Goa, after a petition claimed licenses were granted despite a prior status quo order.

facts.claim: The Supreme Court stayed a 130-acre township project in Carapur village, Goa
facts.quote: The Supreme Court has granted a stay on a contentious 130-acre township project being executed at Carapur village in north Goa via an interim order

facts.claim: after a petition claimed licenses were granted despite a prior status quo order
facts.quote: following a petition that was filed alleging that licenses were granted for the project despite an earlier order of the Supreme Court ordering status quo

ai.background_note: The project faced over five months of local protests in Carapur village before the Supreme Court intervened.
